item.title: Scientists find Ozempic may slow aging itself
item.description: Semaglutide helped older healthy mice live longer while improving memory, muscle function, blood sugar control, and several biological signs of aging.

item.title: 66-million-year-old feather in dinosaur poop may reveal why birds survived the asteroid
item.description: A feather discovered inside 66-million-year-old fossilized dinosaur poop may help explain why modern birds survived the asteroid catastrophe.

item.title: Mercury's surface shows evidence of a fiery past
item.description: Scientists found Mercury's surface has much less silicon dioxide than expected, suggesting an unexpectedly hot volcanic history.

item.title: Researchers develop Wordle strategy with 99% win rate
item.description: Researchers at Binghamton University created a mathematical strategy that solves Wordle with a 99% success rate, rather than relying on simple guessing.
